name: mirrorxr
summary:
MirrorXR projects your Android screen to Quest headsets. You can manually resize the virtual display and operate your phone directly in VR—view messages, play mobile games, and browse short videos without removing the headset. 
MirrorXR supports both real-time screen mirroring and single-app casting with high-resolution passthrough. It operates alongside other VR applications/games, allowing direct touch control on the projected content for a tablet-like interactive experience.
